lead: A transfer list, data-driven with just two pieces of data: all the `items`, and the `value` (keys) of those already on the right. Check items, then click a button in the middle to move them across as a batch.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.root: The root (`data-size` / `data-disabled`) and the move buttons in the middle
styling.header: List header (select all, title, checked count) and the optional search box
styling.body: Scrollable list body, each item (`data-checked` when checked), the read-only text, the empty state
